name: com.gossip.analytics
description: SDK for immersive analytics in XR, VR, AR and 2D/3D games. Track user paths, gaze and object views with unique heatmaps. Powered by AI insights and environment switching for clean data. Fast integration. No per-user fees.

samples.description: Demo scenes, prefabs and example usage of Gossip Analytics SDK

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed
- Removed NuGetForUnity label from all bundled DLL .meta files (LiteDB, R3, Microsoft.Bcl.TimeProvider, System.Threading.Channels, System.ComponentModel.Annotations). These plugins now work as standard Unity plugins without requiring NuGetForUnity to be installed.
- Gossip.cs: EyeTrackingTracker and InputUsageTracker were missing from the RunResendLoopAsync resend worker list. Both trackers now share the same automatic retry resilience as all other trackers.

### Changed
- Updated README with corrected Dependencies section reflecting bundled DLLs and required external packages.
